title: Hat tip to The Hacker News for finding the exploitation evidence for CVE-2026-41709, which was added to CISA's KEV Catalog: WARP PANDA: Mult
content_md:
Hat tip to The Hacker News for finding the exploitation evidence for CVE-2026-41709, which was added to CISA's KEV Catalog: WARP PANDA: Mult

via Mastodon https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/blog/crowdstrike-2026-legal-threat-landscape-report/

CVE-2026-41709.evidence: CrowdStrike credited The Hacker News with finding exploitation evidence; CVE-2026-41709 was added to the CISA KEV Catalog as WARP PANDA, indicating observed in-the-wild exploitation.
